description: A/B virtual portfolio comparison for market-activity momentum and reversion. No broker positions or orders are represented.

targets.rawSql: SELECT portfolio.name, portfolio.strategy, portfolio.horizon, portfolio.initial_cash + COALESCE(sum(position.net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed'), 0) AS realized_equity, count(position.id) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'open') AS open_positions, count(position.id) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed') AS closed_positions, count(position.id) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed' AND position.net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(position.id) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed'), 0) AS win_rate, avg(position.net_return_pct) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed') AS avg_net_return, COALESCE(sum(position.net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE position.status = 'closed'), 0) AS realized_pnl FROM activity_paper_portfolios portfolio LEFT JOIN activity_paper_positions position ON position.portfolio_name = portfolio.name WHERE ('${portfolio}' = 'All' OR portfolio.name = '${portfolio}') GROUP BY portfolio.name, portfolio.strategy, portfolio.horizon, portfolio.initial_cash ORDER BY portfolio.strategy

SELECT exit_time AS time, sum(net_pnl) OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_name ORDER BY exit_time, id)::double precision AS value, portfolio_name AS metric FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND $__timeFilter(exit_time) AND ('${portfolio}' = 'All' OR portfolio_name = '${portfolio}') ORDER BY exit_time ASC

WITH curve AS (SELECT id, portfolio_name, exit_time, sum(net_pnl) OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_name ORDER BY exit_time, id) AS cumulative_pnl FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed'), drawdown AS (SELECT portfolio_name, exit_time, cumulative_pnl - max(cumulative_pnl) OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_name ORDER BY exit_time, id) AS value FROM curve) SELECT exit_time AS time, value::double precision, portfolio_name AS metric FROM drawdown WHERE $__timeFilter(exit_time) AND ('${portfolio}' = 'All' OR portfolio_name = '${portfolio}') ORDER BY exit_time ASC

SELECT entry_time, portfolio_name, ticker, strategy, direction, spike_type, severity, score, entry_price, notional, horizon FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'open' AND ('${portfolio}' = 'All' OR portfolio_name = '${portfolio}') ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT exit_time, portfolio_name, ticker, strategy, direction, spike_type, entry_price, exit_price, gross_return_pct, net_return_pct, costs, net_pnl FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND ('${portfolio}' = 'All' OR portfolio_name = '${portfolio}') ORDER BY exit_time DESC LIMIT 150

SELECT portfolio_name, spike_type, count(*) AS closed_positions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS win_rate, avg(net_return_pct) AS avg_net_return, sum(net_pnl) AS net_pnl FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND ('${portfolio}' = 'All' OR portfolio_name = '${portfolio}') GROUP BY portfolio_name, spike_type ORDER BY net_pnl DESC

SELECT portfolio_name, reason, count(*) AS decisions, max(recorded_at) AS latest_at FROM activity_paper_decisions WHERE decision = 'skip' AND ('${portfolio}' = 'All' OR portfolio_name = '${portfolio}') GROUP BY portfolio_name, reason ORDER BY decisions DESC

SELECT portfolio_name, ticker, count(*) AS closed_positions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS win_rate, avg(net_return_pct) AS avg_net_return, sum(net_pnl) AS net_pnl FROM activity_paper_positions WHERE status = 'closed' AND ('${portfolio}' = 'All' OR portfolio_name = '${portfolio}') GROUP BY portfolio_name, ticker ORDER BY net_pnl DESC
